title: CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging Tissue Staining and Reporter Plate Preparation
author: Diane Saunders
materials: Prepare pre-staining reagents (per individual coverslip): 15-mL beaker with 10 mL acetone After acetone fixation, all incubations and washes in this portion of the protocol are done in 6-well plates using approximately 3 mL of reagent per well (one well per coverslip). If using an alternative container, this volume must be sufficient to submerge the coverslip. 2 wells Hydration Buffer 1 well Pre-staining Fixation Solution (1.6% PFA in Hydration Buffer) 1 well Staining Buffer

Prepare post-staining reagents (per individual coverslip): All incubations and washes in this portion of the protocol, with the exception of Final Fixative, are done in 6-well plates using approximately 3 mL of reagent per well (one well per coverslip). If using an alternative container, this volume must be sufficient to submerge the coverslip. 1 well Post-staining Fixation Solution (1.6% PFA in Staining Buffer) 2 wells Staining Buffer 1 well methanol On ice 3 wells 1X DPBS

Gather supplies and reagents: Nuclear Stain Akoya Biosciences Catalog #7000003 Assay Reagent Akoya Biosciences Catalog #7000002 96 well plate Akoya Biosciences Catalog #7000006 96 well Plate Foil Seals Akoya Biosciences Catalog #7000007 Prepare Reporter Stock Solution: Nuclease-free water - 81.33 % (v/v) 10X CODEX Buffer - 10.00 % (v/v) Assay Reagent - 8.33 % (v/v) CODEX Nuclear Stain - 0.33 % (v/v) A B 1 Total number of samples 3 2 Reporter cycles per sample 10 3 Total volume (mL) 9 4 Nuclease-free water (mL) 7.32 5 10X CODEX buffer (μl) 900 6 Assay Reagent (μl) 750 7 CODEX Nuclear Stain (μl) 30 Table 2: Reporter Stock Solution. Copy and paste all cells above into an Excel sheet, then enter values into cells B1-B2. The volumes for each reagent will automatically be returned in cells B3-B7. ⚠ Ensure you prepare adequate Reporter Stock Solution to account for Blank cycles (no reporters); formulas in Table 2 reflect this.

steps.title: Dry Coverslip
steps.instruction: Remove coverslip from freezer and place face up in a container with a layer of Drierite™ indicating absorbents (Fisher Scientific Catalog #23-116582) for 00:02:00 to dry.

steps.title: Acetone Incubation
steps.instruction: Place coverslip into an individual 10-mL beaker containing acetone, ensuring the entire tissue area is submerged, and incubate for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Second Drying Step
steps.instruction: Carefully remove coverslip from the acetone beaker and place it back into the Drierite container for another 00:02:00.

steps.title: Hydration Washes
steps.instruction: Transfer coverslip to a 6-well plate and perform two washes in 3 mL Hydration Buffer, incubating for 00:02:00 each time.

substeps.instruction: Maintain consistent coverslip order/orientation if processing multiple samples.

steps.title: Pre-Staining Fixation
steps.instruction: Transfer coverslip from the second Hydration Buffer well to a well containing 3 mL Pre-Staining Fixation Solution (1.6% (v/v) PFA in Hydration Buffer) and incubate for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Remove Pre-Staining Fixative
steps.instruction: Wash coverslip twice in 3 mL Hydration Buffer to remove fixative; no incubation is required.

steps.title: Staining Buffer Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate coverslip in 3 mL Staining Buffer for 00:20:00 while placing the 6-well plate on a fixed-angle rocker.

steps.title: Prepare Primary Antibody Cocktail
steps.instruction: Prepare the CODEX Blocking Buffer and add primary antibodies based on optimized dilutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Blocking Buffer: 91% (v/v) Staining Buffer and 2.4% (v/v) each of N, G, J, and S blockers (e.g., for 1 sample: 190 μl Staining Buffer and 5 μl each of N, G, J, and S blockers).
Calculate total antibody volume and subtract this volume from the Blocking Buffer before adding primary antibodies.

steps.title: Apply Antibody Cocktail
steps.instruction: Place coverslip face up in a humidity chamber (e.g., empty pipet tip box with damp paper towel and removable insert) and carefully pipette 200 µL of antibody cocktail solution on top, ensuring the solution pools to cover the entire tissue area.

steps.title: Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at room temperature for 03:00:00.

steps.title: Post-Antibody Washes
steps.instruction: Transfer coverslip from the humidity chamber to a 6-well plate and perform two washes in 3 mL Staining Buffer, incubating for 00:02:00 each time.

steps.title: Post-Staining Fixation
steps.instruction: Transfer coverslip from the second Staining Buffer well to a well containing 3 mL Post-Staining Fixation Solution (1.6% (v/v) PFA in Staining Buffer) and incubate for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Remove Post-Staining Fixative
steps.instruction: Wash coverslip three times in 3 mL DPBS to remove fixative; no incubation is required.

steps.title: Methanol Treatment
steps.instruction: Incubate coverslip in 3 mL cold methanol on ice for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Remove Methanol
steps.instruction: Wash coverslip three times in 3 mL DPBS to remove methanol; no incubation is required.

steps.title: Final Fixation
steps.instruction: Prepare Final Fixative (2% (v/v) Fixative Reagent in DPBS), thawing the reagent immediately before use. Place coverslip face-up in a humidity chamber and carefully pipette 200 µL of Final Fixative onto the coverslip, ensuring it covers the entire tissue area, and incubate at room temperature for 00:20:00.

steps.title: Final Fixative Removal
steps.instruction: Wash coverslip three times in 3 mL DPBS to remove fixative; no incubation is required.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Transfer coverslip into 3 mL of Storage Buffer in a labeled 6-well plate. Seal with parafilm before adding the lid to prevent evaporation and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare Reporter Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare reporter mixes in light-blocking 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes for each reporter cycle.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 250 µL of Reporter Stock Solution per sample into each tube.
Add 5 µL per sample for each required reporter (e.g., for 3 samples: 750 µL Stock and 15 µL each of reporters for channels 1, 2, and 3).
Vortex reporter tubes briefly before adding to the mix.
Mix by gently pipetting up and down or brief vortex, then spin in a benchtop microcentrifuge to collect solution.

steps.title: Prepare Reporter Plate
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of each reporter mix to corresponding wells in a light-protected 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Leave blank wells before and after reporter mixes.
Fill blank cycle wells with 250 µL Reporter Stock Solution (no reporters).

steps.title: Store Reporter Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a foil plate seal and store at 4 °C until imaging.
